QuestInfo.name: [FriendStory] You Look Familiar
QuestInfo.0: The Pale Student Teacher has something to say to you. Speak to him.
QuestInfo.1: The Pale Student Teacher says you remind him of someone. Go see Neinheart in the Office.
QuestInfo.2: Neinheart has put you in charge of maintaining peace at the school among the transformed and entranced students. Good luck.
